brand.name: Gharelu.Bake
brand.logo_specs: Wordmark GHARELU.BAKE, all caps, geometric bold sans-serif, charcoal #333 on dusty pink #F2C8CD.

theme.rationale: A premium bakery leaning towards elegant, warm pastel vibes needs a light, fresh, high-end editorial feel.

usage_rules.backgrounds: Use #FFFDFB as the main site background for a clean, pure aesthetic. Use #F9E8ED for alternating section backgrounds (like Testimonials or Newsletter) to create soft rhythm.
usage_rules.text: Main body text must be #444444 for readability. Headings and primary focal points should be #262626 for stark contrast and premium editorial feel.
usage_rules.accents_and_buttons: Use #EFC7D3 for primary buttons and large aesthetic color blocks. Use #D7869F for hover states, active states, and small pop accents to draw the eye.
usage_rules.borders: Use #F3D6DE for delicate, 1px structural lines (bento grids, cards, dividers) instead of generic greys.

typography.rules: Headings MUST use Poppins ExtraBold (800) with extremely tight tracking to achieve a modern, punchy look. Body text uses Inter for maximum legibility. Never center-align large text bodies; stick to left-alignment for a structured, editorial grid feel.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use a 12-column CSS grid or CSS Subgrid for major structural alignment. Avoid standard Bootstrap-style equal columns. Use asymmetrical Bento grids for Categories and Featured Cakes.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Use rounded-3xl or rounded-full for structural elements to complement the warm, friendly vibe of the bakery. Buttons should be fully pill-shaped (rounded-full).
spacing_and_layout.image_treatment: Spotlight/clipped frames. Product photography must have ample breathing room. Use arched (rounded-t-full) or pill-shaped image masks for editorial elegance.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Implement @studio-freight/lenis for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the 'premium' feel.
motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: Kinetic Hero with a signature line-by-line masked text reveal on load. The image should have a slow, subtle scale-in (1.1 to 1.0) over 2 seconds.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Product cards must feature image slight scale-up on hover, with a subtle box-shadow bloom (shadow-xl with custom pink tint).
motion_and_interaction.parallax: Subtle Framer Motion useTransform parallax on background geometric shapes or floating ingredient imagery (macarons, flour dust) in the Hero or Featured sections.

components.announcement_bar: A slow, editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Background #D7869F, text #FFFDFB. Subtle uppercase Poppins text.
components.navbar: Sticky, glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFFDFB]/80). Border-bottom 1px solid #F3D6DE. Includes Logo, Desktop Links, and a 'Order Now' pill button.
components.hero: Split layout or deep editorial center. Large kinetic typography (Poppins ExtraBold) with masked reveal. Subtle 3D or floating parallax product moment (a pristine cake).
components.featured_cakes: Luxury product cards. Large image, minimal text. Image wrapper rounded-3xl. Background #FFFDFB. Hover: Image scales up, Add to Cart button slides up from bottom.
components.categories: Asymmetrical bento grid. Some items span 2 columns, others 1. Soft pastel backgrounds (#F9E8ED, #EFC7D3) mixing with high-quality photography.
components.why_choose_us: Numbered manifesto chapters (01, 02, 03) in massive Poppins outline text. Overlapping cards or scrolling sticky sections.
components.corporate_gifting: Darker or highly contrasted section to break the rhythm. Background #262626, Text #FFFDFB. Brings out the 'Luxury' aspect.
components.events: Elegant list layout. Date on the left, Title and description in the middle, arrow/link on the right. Border-bottom on each row.
components.gallery_preview: Masonry or staggered grid of high-quality bakery interior and pastry chef shots.
components.instagram_feed: Grid of square posts. Hovering shows a pink overlay (#EFC7D3/80) with a white Instagram icon.
components.testimonials: Soft #F9E8ED background. Large quote marks. Carousels or clean 3-column layout.
components.faq: Clean accordion using Framer Motion for height animation. Border-bottom #F3D6DE for each item.
components.newsletter: Minimalist form. Background #EFC7D3, massive text. Input field with no borders except bottom border, or a large pill-shaped input.
components.footer: Massive typography for the brand name at the bottom. Clean 4-column link structure above it.

image_urls.description: Elegant wedding dessert table with cakes, great for hero parallax or corporate gifting.
Three elegant floral wedding cakes. Can be clipped or masked for product cards.
Pink and brown cupcakes. Fits perfectly with the pastel theme.
Cozy bakery window. Good for location or gallery.
Pastry chef putting icing on cupcakes. Highlights the 'Pure / Premium' artisanal craft.
Close-up chocolate and vanilla macarons. Good for bento grid fillers.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST implement Lenis smooth scrolling. Do not skip this; it is essential for the Awwwards-level feel.
Use Framer Motion for the hero text masked reveal. Wrap each line of the heading in a div with overflow-hidden, and animate the inner text from y: '100%' to y: 0.
Ensure all text colors strictly adhere to the palette. Do not use generic tailwind grays (slate-500, gray-400); use the custom #444444 (Text) and #262626 (Dark).
Do not use Shadcn for this build; the prompt requests custom Awwwards-level UI. Build the components using pure Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Create reusable components in separate files (e.g., Button.jsx, ProductCard.jsx, SectionHeading.jsx).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements to support testing.
Ensure the hero marquee flows seamlessly using react-fast-marquee or framer motion.
Use standard semantic HTML5 tags (section, nav, header, footer).
The client logo provided should be placed in the Navbar and Footer.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not create generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids and bold, large typography.
Add transition effects to all interactive elements specifically (avoid 'transition: all').
Never apply purely transparent backgrounds to floating headers; always use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent fill.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., py-24, py-32).
Avoid AI slop icons; stick to clean React Icons (e.g., from lucide-react or phosphor-icons) and do not use emojis.
